findings.title: Broken Object Level Authorization
findings.description: An authenticated user was able to access another user's resource by changing the user ID.
findings.evidence: User 1 authentication token was used to access /users/2 and the API returned User 2 data with HTTP 200.
findings.recommendation: Implement server-side object ownership authorization for every requested resource.
findings.poc_request:
GET /users/2 HTTP/1.1
Host: 127.0.0.1:8000
Authorization: Bearer token-user-1

findings.title: Sensitive Data Exposure
findings.description: The API response contains sensitive fields that may not be required by the client.
findings.recommendation: Return only the fields required by the client and remove sensitive information from API responses.
findings.poc_request:
GET /users/1 HTTP/1.1
Host: 127.0.0.1:8000
Authorization: Bearer token-user-1

findings.title: Missing Authentication
findings.description: The endpoint returned a successful response without requiring authentication.
findings.evidence: GET /profile was requested without an Authorization header and returned HTTP 200.
findings.recommendation: Require valid authentication before allowing access to protected resources.

findings.title: Missing Rate Limiting
findings.description: The endpoint accepted multiple consecutive requests without returning HTTP 429.
findings.evidence: 10 out of 10 controlled requests were accepted without rate limiting.
findings.recommendation: Implement server-side rate limiting for sensitive endpoints such as login.
